accessibility: Sample shapes and solver fill styles duplicate distinctions; textual cut counts and black overlays do not rely on color alone.
alt_text: Sixteen scatter panels retain both parameter cases, both regions, two return depths and two initial directions. Three marker shapes identify interval endpoints and midpoint; filled and outlined marks retain both solvers. Failed numerical or input-projection points are overlaid, never removed. Panel counts retain all screened and cut intervals. No smooth curves are drawn.
claim_boundary: Outcome-informed, three-sample local event/input-chart screening across all original candidate intervals. No interval-continuity certificate, hidden-boundary exclusion, fitted scalar partition, distinct-critical-point count, C/D assignment, Jones word/arrow, homoclinic proof or whole-plane explanation. Earlier verdicts remain unchanged.

source.aggregation: No coordinate averaging; solver points overlap when in agreement. Screen/cut counts summarize the frozen conjunction within each family.
source.exclusions: Only unavailable requested returns have no coordinates; their counts are printed. Available failed points are retained.
source.selection: All 26 frozen intervals, all 78 paired samples and both solvers, in all 16 families.
source.transformation: Input x and next x are the penultimate and last selected event x. No interpolation, smoothing, fitted curves or error bars.

title: Screening the return geometry before assigning symbols
units: Dimensionless model state coordinates, with no additive tick offsets. Panel ranges differ and are not uncertainty intervals.
